evals.prompt: Run a manual docs consistency bootstrap across the current docs, warp, and warp-server checkouts. Produce the Falconer benchmark scorecard and full audit artifacts, but do not edit docs or notify Slack.
evals.expected_output: A complete preflight, inventory, authority refresh, benchmark scorecard, full run artifact, and generated state tree with no docs edits or Slack post.
assertions: The benchmark accounts for all 24 Falconer cases and negative controls.
Generated state passes schema and fingerprint validation.
Private authority paths and hashes do not appear in candidates, artifacts, state, or report text.
Every reportable finding has a valid full-context adjudication with exact public scope quotes.

evals.prompt: Execute the scheduled docs consistency audit at the inactive UTC half of the Pacific DST schedule.
evals.expected_output: One explicit inactive-guard run-output line with no state read, state write, model call, or Slack post.
assertions: The schedule guard exits before research.

evals.prompt: A required billing authority is unavailable during an incremental audit and one prior conflict is absent from the current extracted claims. Finish the run safely.
evals.expected_output: A partial or blocked artifact that records the missing authority, carries prior active findings forward, emits no resolved lifecycle transition, and sends at most one blocked-run Slack message.
assertions: No prior active finding becomes resolved.
At most one actionable Slack message is produced.

evals.prompt: Start the daylight and standard paired schedules concurrently for the same active Pacific business date.
evals.expected_output: Exactly one invocation durably claims the Pacific date on the standing state branch and continues; every duplicate exits without extraction, state mutation, or Slack reporting.
assertions: The date receipt is claimed and pushed before audit mutation.
A duplicate receipt or losing push race is a successful no-op.
Exactly one invocation can mutate state or produce a notification.
